label: Soil Survey Method standardises field descriptions
summary: N. H. Taylor and I. J. Pohlen published Soil Survey Method, a New Zealand handbook setting common descriptions and mapping practices for soil surveyors. It supplied standards for information later brought into land-use capability inventories.
